title: Strategy chain
description: Discovery/strategy chain: the Strategy Plan lifecycle skills (discover-product, model-domain, recommend-architecture, frontend-architecture, security-strategy, testing-strategy, infrastructure-strategy, cicd-strategy, legacy-inventory) and the `gsd-tools project` command family (mode, strategy-plan, strategy-skipped, strategy-done) backing PROJECT.md ## Mode and ## Strategy Plan queries. The family name stays `project` (67 workflow/agent call sites); a tripwire test guards against upstream re-shadowing it with a hardcoded case.

workflow.certification.description: Certification posture for verify-work's pre-UAT certification step (gsd-core/references/certification.md). 'required' (default): every phase resolves a certification outcome before UAT — certified by the probed driver, 'certification: human (CERT-0)' when no driver is capable (the human UAT that already runs satisfies it), or a recorded 'certification: N/A — no user-facing change'. A skip is always recorded, never silent. 'offer': ask before certifying. 'off': dispatch nothing — the posture itself is recorded as 'certification: off (posture)' so an off-era phase is never mistaken for a failed run; everything else about verify-work is unchanged. The tier, probe results, and mechanism come from .planning/TEST-STRATEGY.md '## Certification' — this key controls only whether the loop acts on them.
